From the Dragon Duel format, Oliver S. Tomajko of the USA playing Dragon Rulers defeated Mao Goto of Japan with Dragon Rulers to earning the title King of Games in Dragon Duels and winning the 2013 Yu-Gi-Oh! Dragon Duel World Championship. Oliver S. Tomajko will receive the “Grandopolis, The Eternal Golden City” prize card, while Mao Goto, Marco Jossue Ruiz Campos of Costa Rica, and Niels Kühnberger of Germany will receive the “E•HERO Pit Boss” prize card.
